SELECT T2.ref2 AS DepartmentID, AVG(T1.rt) AS AverageHourlyPayrate
FROM emp_pay_hist T1
JOIN (
    SELECT ref1, MAX(rt_chng_dt) AS max_dt
    FROM emp_pay_hist
    GROUP BY ref1
) T3 ON T1.ref1 = T3.ref1 AND T1.rt_chng_dt = T3.max_dt
JOIN emp_dept_hist T2 ON T1.ref1 = T2.ref3
GROUP BY T2.ref2

SELECT edh.ref2 AS DepartmentID, SUM(eph.rt) / COUNT(eph.ref1) AS AverageHourlyPayRate
FROM emp_dept_hist edh
JOIN emp_pay_hist eph ON eph.ref1 = edh.ref3
JOIN (
    SELECT ref1, MAX(rt_chng_dt) AS max_rt_chng_dt
    FROM emp_pay_hist
    GROUP BY ref1
) latest_pay ON latest_pay.ref1 = eph.ref1 AND latest_pay.max_rt_chng_dt = eph.rt_chng_dt
GROUP BY edh.ref2

WITH latest_pay AS (
  SELECT eph.ref1, eph.rt
  FROM emp_pay_hist eph
  JOIN (
    SELECT ref1, MAX(rt_chng_dt) AS max_dt
    FROM emp_pay_hist
    GROUP BY ref1
  ) mp ON eph.ref1 = mp.ref1 AND eph.rt_chng_dt = mp.max_dt
)
SELECT edh.ref2 AS DepartmentID, AVG(lp.rt) AS average_hourly_payrate
FROM latest_pay lp
JOIN emp_dept_hist edh ON edh.ref3 = lp.ref1
WHERE edh.end_dt IS NULL
GROUP BY edh.ref2

    JOIN prod p ON b.ref3 = p.prdc_id
    WHERE p.nm = 'HL Road Frame - Black, 58'
      AND b.end_dt IS NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT b.ref2 AS component_id, cte.lvl + 1
    FROM bom b
    JOIN bom_cte cte ON b.ref3 = cte.component_id
    WHERE b.end_dt IS NULL
)
SELECT p.nm, cte.lvl
FROM bom_cte cte
JOIN prod p ON cte.component_id = p.prdc_id

WITH RECURSIVE comp AS (
